comparison_rules.row_order: 最终有 ORDER BY 时逐行，否则忽略顺序但保留重复次数
comparison_rules.column_names: 仅识别到全部输出均为显式 Alias 时比较名称
comparison_rules.column_types: 仅源证据提供字段类型时比较
comparison_rules.recorded_values: 按源输出显示文本比较，不自动套用数值容差

successful_match_rate.meaning: 成功匹配 / 已取得成功源结果；包含已读到成功 .out 的转译失败，不含源端报错或源结果未知

evidence_limits: 只记录观测差异，不自动确定 SQLGlot/Doris/框架的最终责任。
基表、数据阶段和 Session 由外部准备；本报告不证明数据相同。
差异最多保存三个字段或每侧三种记录反例，不保存全量结果或重复的前五行样本。
.out 通常缺少原生类型，并可能混淆 NULL/空字符串或复杂类型显示；匹配不代表这些维度已验证。

queries.source_sql:
SELECT variance(unique1::int4), sum(unique1::int8), regr_count(unique1::float8, unique1::float8)
FROM (SELECT * FROM tenk1
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1) u;
queries.reason: 源端成功，但生成的 Doris SQL 执行报错；具体错误见 doris_error
queries.target_sql: SELECT VAR_SAMP(CAST(unique1 AS INT)), SUM(CAST(unique1 AS BIGINT)), REGR_COUNT(CAST(unique1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(unique1 AS DOUBLE)) FROM (SELECT * FROM tenk1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1) AS u

doris_error.category: 函数不存在或调用形式不受支持

queries.source_sql:
SELECT variance(unique1::int8), avg(unique1::numeric)
FROM (SELECT * FROM tenk1
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1) u;
queries.reason: 返回记录值、重复次数或要求的顺序不同
queries.target_sql: SELECT VAR_SAMP(CAST(unique1 AS BIGINT)), AVG(CAST(unique1 AS DECIMAL)) FROM (SELECT * FROM tenk1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tenk1) AS u

difference.row_order: 忽略顺序，保留重复次数
